## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the change and what the user will experience.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Identify the APK, phone, board, firmware and theme for hardware tests. State which relevant checks were not run and why.

## Documentation and attribution

Link updated English documentation and any upstream sources or license notices relevant to the change. For documentation-only changes, describe the link and consistency checks.

## Remaining limits

Describe known limitations or follow-up work needed to assess this change.
